newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one Oct 9.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Oct 9:

WASHINGTON - A federal judge jailed two senior officials in the D.C. prison system for 180 days after finding they were in criminal contempt of court for retaliating against a female guard who complained about sexual harassment.
WASHINGTON - The head of Fairfax County's printing department is under investigation for allegedly rigging bids in favor of a Chantilly company.

WASHINGTON - Senate Democrats are using a little known device that allows individuals and political action committees that have contributed the maximum allowed directly to candidates to give them an extra boost by donating to the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee.
MORRISTOWN, New Jersey - Republican Bob Dole downshifted to a harsher, more negative message slamming the character and morality of President Clinton.

WASHINGTON - Republican vice presidential candidate Jack Kemp says witnessing racial discrimination directed against his teammates on a professional football team prompted him to pledge to be the "voice" of African Americans in the Republican Party.
WASHINGTON - The toughest criminal sentences are routinely applied to poor minorities, who are not well connected and do not have attorneys capable of making a deal that finesses the rules.
